rounds: I'd pay more for something if I knew the story of the person who made it.
The best adverts hardly show the product at all.
Brands should talk to customers like friends, not like companies.
Fashion brands should use real customers in their adverts instead of models.
I'd buy a T-shirt just because I like the brand's Instagram.
Packaging tells you more about a brand than its adverts do.
If a product is really good, it doesn't need a story.
I'd rather buy from a small Berlin brand than a famous international one.
